title: Stored XSS via avatar upload chained with an authentication bypass in /Attachments leads to ATO in Cervantes version…
description: Cervantes version v1.3-beta contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability via avatar upload combined with an authentication bypass in the /Attachments endpoint. This flaw could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code in another user's browser with elevated privileges, potentially leading to account takeover (ATO). The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 8.7.
